title: Output limit uses the supported Chat Completions field
summary: A short answer is requested with an output limit that must use max_completion_tokens.

requirements.text: The request sends the output limit as max_completion_tokens.
The request omits the unsupported max_tokens field.

grading_notes: gpt-6-luna rejects max_tokens with a 400 unsupported_parameter error (Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead). The response is an ordinary one; these requirements check the request.
